products.name: Soursop
products.storageTips: Room temp until soft; fridge after. Keeps 2-3 days ripe.

products.name: Tiger Nuts (Aya)
products.description: Also called Ofio (Yor), Aki Hausa (Igbo), Aya (Hau).

products.name: Sugarcane
products.storageTips: Room temp; cut pieces in fridge. Keeps 3-5 days.

products.name: Custard Apple (Sweetsop)
products.storageTips: Room temp until soft. Keeps 1-2 days ripe.

products.name: Jackfruit Pods
products.storageTips: Fridge once cut. Keeps 2-3 days cut.

products.name: Sweet Melon
products.storageTips: Room temp to ripen; fridge cut. Keeps 3-5 days ripe.

products.name: Pumpkin
products.storageTips: Whole at room temp. Keeps Weeks whole, 5 days cut.

products.name: Coriander
products.storageTips: Stems in water, fridge. Keeps 4-5 days.

products.name: Basil
products.storageTips: Room temp, stems in water. Keeps 3-4 days.

recipes.title: Mango & Passion Fruit Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Mango and passion fruit on top, tiger nut milk as an option.
steps: Stir oats, milk, yoghurt and chia together in two jars.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with diced mango and passion fruit pulp.
Drizzle with honey if you like.
recipes.tip: Make 3 days at once for a week of grab-and-go breakfasts.

recipes.title: Pawpaw Boats with Yoghurt & Groundnut Crunch
recipes.summary: Crushed groundnuts and pineapple replace imported berries.
steps: Halve the pawpaw lengthways and scoop out the seeds.
Fill each half with yoghurt.
Top with granola, pineapple and crushed groundnuts.
Finish with lime zest and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes with Pineapple Compote
recipes.summary: Warm pineapple compote stands in for maple syrup and berries.
steps: Blend bananas, eggs, oats and cinnamon into a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan, 2 minutes a side.
Simmer pineapple with lime juice for 5 minutes until jammy.
Stack the pancakes and spoon the compote over.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Tatashe & Efo
recipes.summary: The sauce is basically a lighter obe ata. Greens folded in at the end.
steps: Soften chopped onion and garlic in oil.
Add chopped tomatoes, tatashe, ata rodo and cumin. Simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the efo tete, then make four wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the whites set. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Ata Rodo Salsa
recipes.summary: A fresh tomato, onion and ata rodo salsa on top instead of chilli flakes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Dice tomato, onion and ata rodo and toss with the rest of the lime.
Spread avocado, spoon over salsa, top with sliced boiled egg if using.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Sweet potato is cheaper locally than Irish potato and keeps you full longer.
steps: Dice sweet potatoes small and fry in oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add onion and tatashe, cook 4 minutes. Season with paprika and salt.
Stir in efo tete until wilted.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover until set. Finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Plantain & Efo Frittata
recipes.summary: Ripe plantain takes the place of potato. Dodo meets tortilla.
steps: Slice the plantain and fry until golden on both sides.
Add onion, tatashe and ata rodo, cook 3 minutes, then the efo.
Pour over beaten, seasoned eggs.
Cook on low with a lid until set, about 8 minutes. Slice like a cake.
recipes.tip: Cold slices travel well in a lunch box.

recipes.title: Tropical Parfait with Tiger Nut Crumble
recipes.summary: Tiger nut and coconut crumble replaces store-bought granola.
steps: Chop tiger nuts roughly and toast with grated coconut in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Dice pineapple, banana and mango.
Layer yoghurt, fruit and crumble in two glasses.
Finish with honey.
recipes.tip: Off season, pawpaw replaces mango.

recipes.title: Coconut Chia Pudding with Mango
recipes.summary: Fresh coconut milk and dates instead of canned milk and maple syrup.
steps: Blend coconut flesh with warm water and dates, then strain to get sweet coconut milk.
Stir chia seeds into the milk and leave 10 minutes, then stir again.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Top with diced mango and lime zest.

recipes.title: Chilli-Lime Fruit Cup (Yaji Edition)
recipes.summary: Yaji replaces Tajin. Same salty, spicy, sour hit on cold fruit.
steps: Cut all the fruit and cucumber into spears or chunks.
Pile into cups.
Squeeze lime over generously.
Dust with yaji and a pinch of salt just before eating.
recipes.tip: A strong candidate for a ready-to-eat snack box.

recipes.title: Garden Egg Chopped Salad
recipes.summary: Raw garden egg adds a crunchy, slightly bitter bite.
steps: Dice garden eggs, tomatoes, cucumber and onion into small even pieces.
Chop the parsley.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.tip: Scent leaf instead of parsley gives it a distinctly Nigerian finish.

recipes.title: Grilled Pineapple & Chicken Salad
recipes.summary: Yaji-rubbed chicken and local lettuce.
steps: Rub chicken with yaji, oil and salt. Grill or pan-fry 6 minutes a side.
Grill pineapple rings until charred.
Whisk lime juice, honey and oil into a dressing.
Toss lettuce, cucumber, tatashe and spring onion with dressing. Top with sliced chicken and pineapple.

recipes.title: Avocado, Mango & Cucumber Salad
recipes.summary: Ata rodo for heat, coriander for freshness.
steps: Cube avocado, mango and cucumber.
Finely slice onion and ata rodo.
Toss with lime juice, olive oil and salt.
Scatter coriander over the top.
recipes.tip: Best Feb to May. Use pineapple off season.

recipes.title: Watermelon, Cucumber & Grilled Wara Salad
recipes.summary: Grilled wara (local soft cheese) replaces feta.
steps: Slice wara and sear in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Cube watermelon and cucumber, thinly slice the onion.
Toss with lime juice, mint and olive oil.
Top with the warm wara and black pepper.

recipes.title: Lighter Chicken Caesar
recipes.summary: Yoghurt, garlic and lemon dressing instead of a mayo-heavy one.
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Whisk yoghurt, grated garlic, lemon juice, mustard and half the parmesan.
Tear lettuce and toss with tomatoes and dressing.
Top with chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.title: Crunchy Groundnut Cabbage Slaw
recipes.summary: Local groundnut paste and both cabbages.
steps: Finely shred both cabbages and julienne the carrots.
Whisk groundnut paste, lime juice, grated ginger, soy and honey with a splash of water.
Toss vegetables with dressing.
Top with spring onion, coriander and roasted groundnuts.
recipes.tip: Holds well for 2 days, so it is a good meal-prep side.

recipes.title: Greek Salad with Wara
recipes.summary: Wara replaces feta, local green pepper stays.
steps: Cut tomatoes and cucumber into chunks.
Slice green pepper and onion into rings.
Add olives and cubes of wara.
Dress with olive oil, lemon and oregano.

recipes.title: Orange, Spinach & Tiger Nut Salad
recipes.summary: Local oranges or tangerines and tiger nuts for crunch.
steps: Peel and segment the oranges, saving the juice.
Whisk saved juice with lemon, honey and olive oil.
Toss spinach, onion, avocado and orange segments with the dressing.
Scatter sliced tiger nuts on top.
recipes.tip: Best Oct to Jan when citrus is at its peak. Use dates instead of honey to keep it vegan.

recipes.title: Roast Sweet Potato & Efo Salad
recipes.summary: Young efo tete or ugu replaces kale.
steps: Cube sweet potatoes, toss with oil, paprika and salt. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes.
Massage the efo with a little salt and lime juice for 1 minute.
Whisk remaining lime with honey and a splash of oil.
Toss warm potatoes with greens and onion, top with groundnuts.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Bean 'Lagos Caviar'
recipes.summary: Black-eyed beans are the original bean in the US recipe. Tatashe and ata rodo bring it home.
steps: Cook the beans until just tender (or use leftover beans). Cool.
Boil or char the corn and cut off the kernels.
Dice tatashe, tomatoes, onion and ata rodo.
Toss everything with lime juice, olive oil, salt and coriander.
recipes.tip: Even better the next day.

recipes.title: Lagos Nicoise
recipes.summary: Jos potatoes and green beans with canned tuna or sardines.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender. Add green beans for the last 3 minutes. Boil the eggs.
Whisk lemon juice, mustard, olive oil and salt.
Arrange lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, onion, tuna, halved eggs and olives.
Spoon over the dressing.

recipes.title: Green Pawpaw Salad
recipes.summary: Unripe Nigerian pawpaw is the same fruit Thai cooks use. Groundnuts replace peanuts.
steps: Peel and finely shred the green pawpaw and carrot.
Pound garlic and ata rodo, then add lime, fish sauce and honey.
Lightly bruise tomatoes and green beans in the dressing.
Toss with pawpaw and carrot. Top with groundnuts.
recipes.tip: Use soy sauce instead of fish sauce to make it vegan.

recipes.title: Moroccan Carrot & Orange Salad
recipes.summary: Jos carrots, local oranges and fresh mint.
steps: Coarsely grate the carrots.
Segment the orange and add the juice.
Season with lemon, cumin, cinnamon, olive oil and salt.
Toss with torn mint.

recipes.title: Beetroot, Orange & Avocado Salad
recipes.summary: Local beetroot, boiled rather than roasted to save gas.
steps: Boil beetroot until tender, about 40 minutes. Cool, peel and slice.
Segment the orange and slice the avocado.
Arrange on lettuce with onion.
Dress with lemon, honey and olive oil. Top with groundnuts.

recipes.title: Kachumbari
recipes.summary: Ata rodo for heat. Built to sit next to grilled fish, suya or rice.
steps: Dice tomatoes and cucumber.
Slice onion very thinly and rinse in cold water to tame it.
Finely chop ata rodo and coriander.
Toss with lime juice and salt.

recipes.title: Chicken Suya Power Bowl
recipes.summary: Suya-spiced chicken with the classic suya garnish of onion, tomato and cabbage.
steps: Cook the rice.
Coat chicken in yaji and oil, then grill or pan-fry 6 minutes a side. Slice.
Shred cabbage, slice tomatoes, onion and cucumber, slice the avocado.
Build bowls: rice, vegetables, chicken. Finish with lime and extra yaji.
recipes.tip: Swap rice for quinoa or extra cabbage on lower-carb days.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowl with Dodo
recipes.summary: Ripe plantain and black-eyed beans take the place of pinto beans and sweet corn.
steps: Cook rice. Warm beans with cumin and salt.
Slice plantain and roast or pan-fry until caramelised. Char the corn and slice off the kernels.
Make a quick salsa: tomato, onion, ata rodo, coriander, lime.
Build bowls with lettuce, rice, beans, plantain, corn, salsa and sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Mango Prawn Poke-Style Bowl
recipes.summary: Cooked prawns instead of raw fish, which is safer for home delivery. Mango for sweetness.
steps: Cook rice and let it cool slightly.
Saute prawns 2 to 3 minutes until pink. Toss in soy, sesame oil, honey and lime.
Dice mango, cucumber and avocado. Shred the carrot.
Build bowls and top with spring onion.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken & Broccoli Bowl
recipes.summary: Fresh ginger and garlic glaze. Green beans are the budget swap for broccoli.
steps: Cook rice.
Simmer soy, honey, grated ginger and garlic for 2 minutes to make the glaze.
Pan-fry chicken pieces until cooked, then toss in the glaze.
Steam broccoli and sliced carrots 4 minutes. Serve over rice with spring onion.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Bean Falafel Bowl
recipes.summary: Black-eyed beans (akara's cousin) replace chickpeas. Scent leaf joins parsley.
steps: Blend soaked, peeled beans with onion, garlic, herbs, cumin and salt into a coarse paste.
Shape into small patties and bake at 200C for 20 minutes, flipping once (or shallow fry).
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice and a little grated garlic.
Serve with chopped lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, pita and the yoghurt sauce.
recipes.tip: The paste is basically akara batter with herbs, so most Nigerian cooks nail it first try.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Buddha Bowl with Ugu Pesto
recipes.summary: Ugu and groundnut pesto replaces tahini dressing.
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato with oil and salt at 200C for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cook quinoa or rice. Warm the chickpeas or beans.
Blend ugu, groundnuts, garlic, lemon, olive oil and salt into a pesto.
Build bowls with grain, sweet potato, beans, cucumber and grated carrot. Spoon over the pesto.

recipes.title: Bibimbap-Style Beef Bowl
recipes.summary: Efo tete stands in for spinach. A honey and ata rodo sauce replaces gochujang.
steps: Cook rice.
Brown beef with garlic and half the soy. Saute mushrooms, then wilt the efo.
Mix the rest of the soy with honey, sesame oil and finely chopped ata rodo.
Top rice with julienned carrot and cucumber, the cooked vegetables, beef and a fried egg. Drizzle sauce.

recipes.title: Thai Groundnut Wara Bowl
recipes.summary: Wara soya is Nigerian tofu. Groundnut sauce does the rest.
steps: Press and cube the wara soya, then pan-fry until golden.
Blend groundnut paste, soy, lime juice, ginger, garlic, dates and warm water into a pourable sauce.
Cook rice or noodles. Shred cabbage and carrot, slice cucumber.
Build bowls, pour over sauce, top with spring onion and coriander.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Gyro Bowl with Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Tzatziki made with local cucumber, mint or parsley.
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil and salt for 10 minutes, then grill and slice.
Cook rice.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze dry, mix with yoghurt, garlic and chopped mint.
Build bowls with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, the rest of the cucumber, chicken and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Coconut Prawn & Mango Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in fresh coconut milk with a mango salsa.
steps: Cook rice in fresh coconut milk topped up with water.
Saute prawns with garlic and a pinch of salt, 3 minutes.
Dice mango, tatashe, onion and ata rodo. Toss with lime and coriander.
Serve rice topped with prawns and salsa.

recipes.title: Lighter Chicken Shawarma
recipes.summary: Grilled not fried, yoghurt-garlic sauce instead of mayo, twice the vegetables.
steps: Toss sliced chicken with curry powder, paprika, oil and salt. Pan-grill until charred.
Mix yoghurt, grated garlic, lemon and salt.
Shred cabbage and carrot, slice cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Spread sauce on warm wraps, fill with vegetables and chicken, roll tight and toast seam-side down.
recipes.tip: The one people will order every week. Make it the hero of the launch menu.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
recipes.summary: Croaker or tilapia, pineapple and ata rodo salsa, cabbage slaw.
steps: Season fish with paprika, salt and lime. Pan-fry 3 minutes a side and flake.
Dice pineapple, onion and ata rodo. Mix with coriander and lime.
Shred cabbage and toss with lime and salt.
Warm tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, salsa and avocado.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Local iceberg cups with groundnuts for crunch.
steps: Finely chop or mince the chicken.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, add chicken, cook until no longer pink.
Add diced carrot and tatashe, soy and lime. Cook 2 minutes.
Spoon into lettuce cups. Top with spring onion and crushed groundnuts.
recipes.tip: Low-carb and quick. A strong pick for the weight-management goal filter.

recipes.title: Suya Beef Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Suya beef with the full suya garnish, wrapped in lettuce.
steps: Rub thin beef slices with yaji, oil and salt.
Sear in a very hot pan, 1 to 2 minutes a side.
Slice onion, tomatoes and cucumber.
Wrap beef and vegetables in lettuce leaves. Squeeze lime over.

recipes.title: Corn, Tatashe & Efo Quesadilla
recipes.summary: Local sweet corn, tatashe and efo inside.
steps: Slice corn off the cob. Saute with onion, tatashe, ata rodo and cumin for 4 minutes.
Stir in efo until wilted.
Layer half of each tortilla with cheese and filling, fold, then toast 2 minutes a side.
Cut into wedges. Serve with sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Egg & Avocado Breakfast Wrap
recipes.summary: The filling is a Nigerian egg sauce: tomato, onion and pepper scrambled with eggs.
steps: Saute diced onion, tomatoes and ata rodo in oil for 3 minutes.
Add efo, then the beaten eggs. Scramble softly.
Warm the wraps and spread with mashed avocado.
Fill with eggs and roll.

recipes.title: Bean & Plantain Burrito
recipes.summary: Ewa and dodo, the Nigerian favourite, wrapped Mexican-style.
steps: Warm beans with cumin, lightly mashing half.
Slice and fry the plantain until golden.
Make a quick salsa with tomato, onion, ata rodo and lime.
Fill wraps with beans, plantain, cheese, salsa and lettuce. Roll and toast.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
recipes.summary: Sweet potato and local green beans on one tray.
steps: Heat oven to 200C. Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, quarter the onion.
Toss chicken and vegetables with oil, paprika, crushed garlic, lemon zest, rosemary and salt.
Roast 25 minutes, add green beans, roast 10 more.
Squeeze lemon over before serving.
recipes.tip: One tray, one wash-up. The format meal-kit customers love most.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken & Veg Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: The 'Chinese restaurant' order Lagos loves, made with half the oil.
steps: Slice chicken thin and toss with 1 tbsp soy and the cornflour.
Stir-fry chicken in a very hot pan until browned. Remove.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, broccoli, carrots and peppers for 3 to 4 minutes.
Return chicken with the rest of the soy and a splash of water. Toss, top with spring onion. Serve with rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Pumpkin & Ugu
recipes.summary: Elegede pumpkin, ugu greens and scent leaf, which is a basil, just like Thai basil.
steps: Fry curry paste with bruised lemongrass, ginger and garlic for 1 minute.
Add chicken and brown lightly, then pour in coconut milk.
Add pumpkin and simmer 12 minutes until tender. Add green beans for the last 4.
Stir in ugu and scent leaf, season with fish sauce and lime. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Tatashe and green pepper with local onions.
steps: Slice beef very thin across the grain. Toss with 1 tbsp soy and cornflour.
Sear beef in batches in a very hot pan. Remove.
Stir-fry onion, peppers, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Return beef with remaining soy and a splash of water. Finish with spring onion. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Prawn Cauliflower Fried 'Rice'
recipes.summary: Party fried rice vegetables, with cauliflower standing in for rice.
steps: Pulse cauliflower in a blender until rice-sized.
Stir-fry prawns with garlic and ginger, 2 minutes. Remove.
Stir-fry diced carrots and green beans 3 minutes, push aside, scramble the eggs.
Add cauliflower and soy, fry 4 minutes. Return prawns, finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Grilled Fish with Mango Salsa & Roast Plantain
recipes.summary: Croaker or tilapia, and plantain roasted rather than fried.
steps: Rub fish with grated garlic, ginger, paprika, lime and salt. Rest 10 minutes.
Roast plantain slices at 200C for 20 minutes, flipping once.
Grill or oven-bake the fish for 15 to 20 minutes.
Mix diced mango, onion, ata rodo, coriander and lime. Spoon over the fish.
recipes.tip: Mango Feb to May. Pineapple works the rest of the year.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Efo Curry
recipes.summary: Efo tete for spinach, fresh coconut milk for cream.
steps: Soften onion, then add garlic, ginger, ata rodo, curry powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook down 8 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in efo until wilted. Serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Caribbean Curry Chicken & Sweet Potato
recipes.summary: Scotch bonnet is already ours. Sweet potato replaces potato.
steps: Season chicken with curry powder, thyme, garlic, ginger and salt.
Brown chicken in oil, add onion, tomatoes and the whole ata rodo.
Add water to half-cover, simmer 20 minutes.
Add cubed sweet potato and simmer 15 more until tender. Finish with spring onion. Serve with rice.
recipes.tip: Leave the ata rodo whole for flavour without too much heat.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato & Basil Garden Pasta
recipes.summary: Plum tomatoes plus tatashe for a sweeter sauce. Scent leaf works if basil is scarce.
steps: Cook pasta.
Soften onion and garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes and tatashe. Simmer 12 minutes.
Add mushrooms and spinach, cook 2 minutes.
Toss with pasta, torn basil and parmesan.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tatashe with Beef & Corn
recipes.summary: The filling is a jollof-spiced rice and beef mix.
steps: Halve tatashe and remove seeds.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, ata rodo, curry and thyme. Add chopped tomatoes and corn, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice.
Fill the peppers, top with cheese and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Light Vegetable Egg Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Party fried rice vegetables, with a fraction of the oil.
steps: Dice carrots and green beans. Slice corn off the cob.
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan, then remove.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and vegetables 4 minutes.
Add rice, soy and curry powder. Fry until hot, fold in eggs and spring onion.
recipes.tip: Day-old rice fries best.

recipes.title: Kerala-Style Okra & Prawn Coconut Curry
recipes.summary: Nigerian okra cooked whole so it stays crisp, not slimy.
steps: Trim okra and leave whole. Pan-fry in oil for 4 minutes, then set aside.
Soften onion, add garlic, ginger, grated turmeric, ata rodo and curry powder.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, then the coconut milk.
Add prawns and okra, simmer 4 minutes. Finish with lime. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Garden Egg Ratatouille
recipes.summary: Garden egg replaces aubergine. Zucchini optional.
steps: Cut all vegetables into similar bite-sized chunks.
Soften onion and garlic in olive oil, add peppers for 5 minutes.
Add garden eggs and zucchini for 5 minutes, then tomatoes and thyme.
Simmer gently 25 minutes. Finish with torn scent leaf.
recipes.tip: Serve with rice, bread or grilled fish. Better the next day.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken with Scent Leaf Chimichurri
recipes.summary: Scent leaf (efirin) and parsley base, ata rodo for heat.
steps: Roast sweet potato wedges at 200C for 25 minutes.
Season and grill the chicken.
Finely chop scent leaf, parsley, garlic and ata rodo. Mix with vinegar, lime, olive oil and salt.
Slice chicken and spoon chimichurri over it. Serve with the wedges.
recipes.tip: Chimichurri keeps a week in the fridge. Great on fish and eggs too.

recipes.title: Foil-Baked Fish with Lemon, Tomato & Greens
recipes.summary: Local fish, ginger and efo, with potatoes on the side.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender.
Lay efo on foil, top with fish, sliced tomatoes, onion, garlic, ginger and lemon slices.
Drizzle with olive oil, season, scatter herbs and seal the parcels.
Bake at 200C for 15 to 18 minutes. Serve with potatoes.

recipes.title: Ugu & Groundnut Pesto Pasta
recipes.summary: Ugu and groundnuts replace basil and pine nuts, which cost a fortune here.
steps: Cook pasta.
Blanch ugu for 30 seconds, then cool in cold water and squeeze dry.
Blend ugu, scent leaf, groundnuts, garlic, lemon, parmesan and olive oil.
Toss pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water. Top with halved tomatoes.
recipes.tip: Skip the parmesan and add extra groundnuts to make it vegan.

recipes.title: Roasted Pumpkin & Ginger Soup
recipes.summary: Elegede pumpkin, lots of ginger and fresh coconut milk.
steps: Roast pumpkin, carrots, onion and garlic with oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Transfer to a pot with ginger, ata rodo and stock. Simmer 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in coconut milk and season.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato & Tatashe Soup
recipes.summary: Basically a smooth, lighter obe ata you eat with a spoon.
steps: Halve tomatoes and tatashe, roast with onion, garlic and ata rodo at 200C for 25 minutes.
Blend with stock until smooth.
Simmer 5 minutes and season.
Serve with torn basil and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Coconut Lemongrass Chicken Soup
recipes.summary: Fresh coconut milk, local lemongrass, and ginger in place of galangal.
steps: Make fresh coconut milk from the coconut.
Simmer stock with bruised lemongrass, sliced ginger and ata rodo for 5 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms, cook 8 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk, fish sauce and lime juice. Top with coriander and spring onion.

recipes.title: Garden Minestrone
recipes.summary: Cabbage, green beans and black-eyed beans make it local.
steps: Soften diced onion, carrots and garlic in olive oil.
Add chopped tomatoes, diced potato and stock. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage, green beans, beans and pasta. Simmer 10 more.
Season and finish with herbs.

recipes.title: Baked Plantain Chips with Lime & Yaji
recipes.summary: Baked, not deep-fried.
steps: Peel green plantains and slice very thin.
Toss with oil and salt, spread on a tray in one layer.
Bake at 180C for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once.
Finish with lime zest and yaji.

recipes.title: Guacamole with Garden Egg Crudites
recipes.summary: Garden egg, cucumber and carrot sticks to dip instead of tortilla chips.
steps: Mash avocados with lime juice and salt.
Fold in diced tomato, onion, ata rodo and coriander.
Cut garden eggs, cucumber and carrots into sticks.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Garden Egg Baba Ganoush
recipes.summary: Charred garden eggs, with groundnut paste in place of tahini.
steps: Char garden eggs over a flame or under the grill until soft and blackened.
Peel and roughly chop.
Mash with garlic, lemon, groundnut paste, cumin, olive oil and salt.
Top with parsley. Serve with carrot sticks or bread.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Yaji Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Yaji-spiced yoghurt dip instead of ketchup.
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt.
Roast at 200C for 25 to 30 minutes.
Mix yoghurt with yaji, grated garlic and lime.
Serve wedges with the dip.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Bean Hummus with Veggie Sticks
recipes.summary: Black-eyed beans and groundnut paste replace chickpeas and tahini.
steps: Blend beans, groundnut paste, garlic, lemon juice, cumin and olive oil with a splash of cold water until very smooth.
Season with salt.
Cut carrots, cucumber, tatashe and garden eggs into sticks.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Roasted Corn with Lime & Yaji Butter
recipes.summary: Roadside roasted corn meets yaji and lime. Pair with ube in season.
steps: Roast corn over a flame or under the grill until charred all over.
Mix soft butter with yaji.
Brush corn with yaji butter.
Squeeze lime over and scatter coriander and cheese.
recipes.tip: Fresh corn Apr to Aug. Bundle with ube as a rainy season drop.

recipes.title: Okra & Corn Succotash
recipes.summary: Nigerian okra and fresh corn, with ata rodo.
steps: Slice okra into rounds and cut kernels off the corn.
Soften onion, garlic and tatashe in oil and butter.
Add okra and corn, cook 6 minutes on high so the okra stays crisp.
Add diced tomatoes and ata rodo, cook 3 minutes. Season.

recipes.title: Banana Groundnut Nice Cream
recipes.summary: Roasted groundnuts and dates make it taste like a Nigerian childhood treat.
steps: Slice ripe bananas and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Blend frozen banana with dates and a splash of milk until creamy.
Pulse in half the groundnuts.
Serve straight away, topped with the rest of the groundnuts and cinnamon.
recipes.tip: The best use for overripe bananas. Pairs well with a discounted 'smoothie bananas' SKU.

recipes.title: Grilled Pineapple with Coconut & Lime
recipes.summary: Toasted fresh coconut and lime zest.
steps: Cut pineapple into thick wedges.
Brush with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Grill or pan-sear until caramelised, 3 minutes a side.
Toast grated coconut in a dry pan. Scatter over with lime zest.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Rice Pudding
recipes.summary: Local rice cooked in fresh coconut milk and sweetened with dates.
steps: Make coconut milk from the coconut, blending in the dates.
Simmer rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt, stirring often, for 25 to 30 minutes until creamy.
Cool slightly and stir in lime zest.
Serve topped with sliced mango.
recipes.tip: Best Feb to May.

recipes.title: Watermelon Lime Ice Pops
recipes.summary: Watermelon, lime and mint.
steps: Blend watermelon with lime juice and honey.
Finely chop mint and stir it in.
Pour into ice pop moulds or small cups with sticks.
Freeze at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: No-Churn Mango Passion Sorbet
recipes.summary: Ripe local mangoes need almost no sugar.
steps: Peel and cube mangoes and freeze for 4 hours.
Blend frozen mango with passion fruit pulp, lime and honey until smooth.
Serve soft, or freeze 1 hour for scoops.
recipes.tip: Best Feb to May.

recipes.title: Crunchy Apple, Pear & Grape Salad
recipes.summary: Roasted groundnuts instead of walnuts, yoghurt instead of mayo.
steps: Core and dice apples and pear. Halve the grapes.
Mix yoghurt, lemon juice and honey.
Toss fruit with lettuce and dressing.
Top with roasted groundnuts.
recipes.tip: A natural recipe for the premium fruit box.
